xThread: Data ownership and portability are critical factors when choosing a CRM. If you outgrow your platform or need regular backups, how easily can you extract your customer records, deals, and activity histories?

We compared HubSpot and Pipedrive to see how they handle CRM data exports. While both support standard formats like CSV and Excel, their limits on historical records, associated data exports, and automation vary significantly.

For official export documentation, check HubSpot's guide: https://knowledge.hubspot.com/import-and-export/export-records and Pipedrive's support article: https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/how-can-i-free-up-space

reddit.title: CRM Data Export and Portability Buyer Guide: HubSpot vs Pipedrive
reddit.body:
When evaluating CRM software, data portability is often overlooked until a migration or audit is required. We put together a comparison of HubSpot and Pipedrive focusing strictly on data export capabilities, including supported formats, record limitations, API extraction, and associated data handling.

You can review the official export documentation directly via HubSpot (https://knowledge.hubspot.com/import-and-export/export-records) and Pipedrive (https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/how-can-i-free-up-space).

Read the full buyer guide here: https://stackpilot-ai.hithisisakii09.workers.dev/guides/crm-data-export-and-portability-guide/
